author: National Geographic
description:
How do you make a mummy? Expedition leader Ulla Lohmann travels to New Guinea to learn the lessons of the Anga people. In a cliffside gallery are long dead ancestors, their faces still similar to their living selves. Who are these mystery mummies of New Guinea?
